text: The Bidder's turnover for the most recently closed financial year shall be at least EUR 3,000,000.
The Bidder shall employ at least 15 electrical professionals in its own workforce.
The Bidder shall have at least three (3) comparable reference projects within the last five years.
The Bidder shall hold a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate at the time the quotation is submitted.
The Bidder shall hold an F-gas regulation qualification where the work involves refrigeration or air-conditioning equipment.
The Bidder's turnover for the most recently closed financial year shall be at least EUR 5,000,000.
Describe how environmental impacts (waste, emissions, noise) will be managed during maintenance and repair work on site.
Describe the scope and frequency of scheduled HVAC maintenance proposed.
Describe how the condition of roofing, cladding, and building fabric will be assessed as part of the maintenance scope.
Describe internal quality control and testing procedures applied to completed work.
State the warranty period offered on equipment and materials installed.
Describe how site-access and security procedures will be observed by maintenance personnel working within an active production facility.
Describe the programme for statutory periodic inspection of electrical installations.
State the proposed content and frequency of scheduled maintenance visits.
Describe how the existing asset register and technical documentation will be received and maintained.
Describe the commissioning and testing procedure following equipment replacement.
Provide a method statement for carrying out installation work without disrupting production.
Describe the escalation path for a fault not resolved within the agreed response time.
Describe the approach to scheduled testing and maintenance of fire protection systems.
Describe how continuity will be maintained if key personnel leave or are reassigned.
Describe how condition-monitoring data will be collected and reported to the Buyer.
State typical lead times for common spare parts.
State any retention percentage proposed on invoiced amounts pending completion or defect-liability sign-off.
Confirm acceptance of the payment terms set out in this request and its annexes.
State proposed invoicing frequency and confirm electronic invoicing capability.
Describe how subcontractor costs will be made transparent where subcontractors are used.
Set out the proposed pricing structure.
Propose a discount structure applicable as order volumes increase.
Provide a cost breakdown supporting the headline price quoted.
Subcontractor list (Liite 3) to be completed and enclosed, listing any subcontractors the Bidder intends to use.
CVs of key personnel proposed for the contract.
Tender form (Liite 1), the Buyer's standard tender form, to be completed and enclosed.
Description of the quality system.
The quotation document shall not exceed 20 pages, excluding attachments.
Prices shall be quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not in EUR per month.
All prices shall be quoted excluding VAT, in euro.
Quotations shall note the time zone and closing time given for the submission deadline in Section 7.
The quotation shall be submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection.

The closing time is the time the quotation is recorded as received by the Buyer's mailbox (Finnish time), not the time sent; late receipt after 14:00:00 is treated as late regardless of sender's local time or system clock.
The office wing's passenger lift requires maintenance in compliance with applicable lift regulations; describe how this will be met and documented.
Describe how maintenance activity, findings, and outstanding items will be reported to the Buyer's facilities contact.
List the trade qualifications and site-induction requirements personnel will hold when working in the production areas.
Describe how any subcontracted trades will be selected and supervised.
Submit a preventive maintenance plan covering the system categories described.
State the proposed response time by severity category and describe out-of-hours cover.
State proposed response times for corrective (non-emergency) maintenance requests, distinct from fault-response times.
Production-area access requires prior notice to the shift supervisor; maintenance work affecting production lines shall be scheduled outside core production hours wherever practicable.
Describe the bonus-malus arrangement proposed for over- and under-performance against agreed service levels.
State whether any advance payment is requested, and on what basis.
Prices quoted shall remain valid for 90 days from the closing date given in Section 7 of the main request.
The minimum font size used throughout the quotation, including this annex's commercial schedules where completed by the Bidder, shall be 11 pt.
Description of the environmental management system in use, if any.
Trade register extract, issued no earlier than three months before the closing date.
Power of attorney for the person signing the quotation, where that person is not a registered signatory of the Bidder.

The Contractor's quotation, including all forms and attachments required -- the tender form (Liite 1), the reference form (Liite 2), and the subcontractor list (Liite 3) where applicable -- is incorporated into and forms part of the agreement by reference.
The Contractor shall ensure personnel meet the qualification and access requirements described in Liite A and observe the Buyer's site rules at all times.
Each party's liability is limited as set out in the Contractor's accepted commercial terms, save for liability that cannot be limited by law.
